smalltalk_sg.headline: Syed Saddiq Invites Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to October Wedding
smalltalk_sg.body: Malaysian politician Syed Saddiq Abdul Rahman has invited Singapore Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to his wedding in October. He joked that the invitation upgraded bilateral relations to wedding-invitation status.

smalltalk_sg.headline: PM Lawrence Wong Addresses Salary Discussions in Parliament
smalltalk_sg.body: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong reiterated that salary increases are about Singapore's future rather than himself or the PAP government. He thanked the Members of Parliament who participated in the discussion.

personal_hk.headline: 動物權益團體呼籲市民抵制啟德馬術表演
personal_hk.body:
動保組織PETA指控馬術表演「Cavalluna」涉嫌虐待動物，呼籲市民抵制該演出。
該節目由香港賽馬會主要贊助及主辦，於啟德體育園由本週二公演至本週日。

personal_sg.headline: Malaysian Politician Syed Saddiq Invites Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to Wedding
personal_sg.body:
Malaysian politician Syed Saddiq Abdul Rahman invited Singapore Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to his October wedding.
He joked that he had upgraded bilateral relations to wedding-invitation status.

personal_sg.headline: PM Lawrence Wong Speaks on Salary Increases
personal_sg.body:
Prime Minister Lawrence Wong stated that higher salaries are about Singapore's future rather than himself or the PAP government.
He thanked the MPs who participated in the parliamentary discussion.
